_comment: Copy to config.json on the Windows rig and edit. config.json is gitignored — it holds machine-local paths and model filenames that differ per box.

comfy._comment: Two ComfyUI instances, one pinned per GPU. ComfyUI will not split a single generation across cards, so throughput comes from running two servers, not one.

models._comment: Fill in the exact filenames as they appear in ComfyUI's dropdowns. SDXL-class is the sweet spot on 3090s — no fp8 acceleration on Ampere makes Flux painful for iteration.

rig._comment: Must match the shipped manifests: 24x32 frames, anchor at the feet. Do not change without regenerating every sprite.

paths._comment: Relative to repo root. Generated intermediates stay out of git.
